accent-brass.usage: Countdown rails, node values, selected controls, and urgent decisions.

accent-blue.usage: Power glow, active plant details, and contrast against the industrial field.

page-bg.usage: Page background and deep canvas surround.

rules: Pressure first: timer, blast risk, and repair rewards must be visible before instructions.
Readable chaos: keep the board wacky but make player positions, node values, and scores scannable.
No SaaS polish: avoid rounded cards, hero metrics, glassmorphism, and sterile enterprise spacing.

motion.principle: Snappy arcade motion, with blinking only for countdown urgency.
motion.avoid: Large decorative motion that competes with gameplay state.
